provenance: Transcribed verbatim from the four Gherkin scenarios authored in scopes.md § SCOPE-01 § Gherkin. No scenario was invented, merged, split or renamed; the SCN-B003-* ids are the ids already used by scopes.md, spec.md and state.json.findingsLedger.

scenarios.title: The reconciled TP-10-02 asserts brief visibility in the Brief view

gherkin.given: an ordinary tool page hosting a data-rlbrief-mount and a coherent current brief graph, and the Feature 012 shell has adopted the mount into its "brief" view panel
gherkin.when: TP-10-02 loads the page, waits for the shell to report ready, and drives the real rlviews control to the Brief view
gherkin.then: the mount is ready and visible, and data-rlbrief-state is "ready"

linkedTests.testId: static loader verifies coherent current objects and fetches history only after selection

scenarios.title: The view switch does not weaken any network-window assertion

gherkin.given: TP-10-02 has driven the shell to the Brief view
gherkin.then: no history partition has been requested before "Open history", the Power mode switch performs no refetch, opening history fetches the pointer and index only, and selecting one filter fetches exactly one partition

linkedTests.testId: static loader verifies coherent current objects and fetches history only after selection

scenarios.title: The fail-closed integrity path is reconciled identically

gherkin.given: a brief graph whose read object fails its SHA-256 check
gherkin.when: TP-10-02 drives the shell to the Brief view and waits for the mount
gherkin.then: data-rlbrief-state is "integrity-error" and no partial evidence is rendered

linkedTests.testId: static loader verifies coherent current objects and fetches history only after selection

scenarios.title: The ratified sibling contract is unchanged

gherkin.when: the suite is re-run after the reconciliation
gherkin.then: all 13 pass and the file is unmodified

linkedTests.testId: Regression: valid added registry source receives the shared mount with no page-specific branch
